subject: Error in fdata[1, 1] : incorrect number of dimensions

messages.author: d334869cda817467
messages.subject: Error in fdata[1, 1] : incorrect number of dimensions
parts:
I did a quick search and nothing came up.

My issue is simple. I'm using renderDataTable() to send the content of a data frame to the UI, where dataTableOutput() is then presenting the table in the browser.

When I use the search box of the data table, I get this error:

Error in fdata[1, 1] : incorrect number of dimensions

I tried stripping any logic from the renderDataTable() call, to ensure that all that is being sent is just a plain data table, in case my logic had anything to do with it (which I don't think it would).

I'm not sure what's going on here - any ideas?

Thanks, in advance.
